subject: Helios Tech — on-site tech briefing & exec roundtable coordination
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>

Subject: Helios Tech — coordinating on-site tech briefing and exec roundtable

Hi Lia —

Thanks for taking the call earlier. Per our conversation, Helios team mentioned wanting a short hands-on tech briefing for your engineering org followed by an exec roundtable with a couple of your VPs during our visit the week of Aug 9. Proposed format:

- 60 min technical deep-dive (SE-led, live demo + Q&A)
- 30 min ops/procurement sync (Neha) to discuss access, logging, data flow
- 45 min exec roundtable (product + engineering leadership)

Grace — can you confirm SE availability Aug 10–12? We expect 4–6 Helios engineers (Will + 2 others) plus 2 execs.

Lia — can you confirm which date works best, whether you prefer Redwood to host at your Sunnyvale office or meet near the conference hotel, and whether procurement needs any pre-visit paperwork?

Attachments: redwood-tech-brief.pdf (deck)

Next steps: Lia to confirm date & site; Grace to confirm SE timing; Neha to outline procurement checklist.

Best,
Olga
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Olga —

Thanks, this looks good. Aug 11 or Aug 12 are our preferred windows — Aug 11 morning would be ideal (before our weekly all-hands). We can host at our Sunnyvale office (floorplan attached).

Quick notes from our side:
- Will (CC) will own engineer invites — likely 3 from infra, 2 from app team.
- Procurement (procurement@heliostech.com) needs a vendor security questionnaire and an insurance certificate; we can start that in parallel.
- Execs: VP Product (K. Rao) and VP Engineering (S. Alvarez) are tentatively available Aug 11 1:00–2:00pm PT for the roundtable.

I attached helios-office-floorplan.pdf to indicate meeting room sizes. Could you share a short agenda and expected attendee list?

Regards,
Lia Chen
Principal IT Program Manager | Helios Tech

Thanks for the heads up — happy to lead the SE portion. Aug 11 AM works for me; I can do a 9:30–11:00 slot for the deep-dive. Proposed SE agenda (high level):

1) 15m quick architecture recap (what Helios already runs + integration points)
2) 25m live demo of typical inference flow (KV caching + latency tuning)
3) 20m troubleshooting & security patterns (KMS/HSM, network egress)
4) 10m open Q&A + next steps (rollout checklist)

I will bring a laptop + local model artifacts; do you want us to bring a portable NVIDIA dev box for latency numbers or use Helios infra? (I recommend bringing the box so we can show controlled profiling.)

Also: Olga, can you confirm headcount for the exec roundtable and whether we should prep a short one-slide SLAs/cost tradeoffs summary (I'll draft if helpful).

- Grace

Hi Lia / team —

Thanks for flagging procurement requirements. To keep the visit greenlit we typically need:
- Completed vendor security questionnaire (I can send our standard template)
- Proof of COI (certificate of insurance)
- On-site visitor / NDA form for any non-employee attendees
- Any special data access or test datasets requested in advance

I'll attach the MOP-template (method of procedure) and the vendor questionnaire after this note. Lia — if you can confirm the primary procurement contact and whether your security team requires additional evidence (SOC2/AICPA report), we'll start the exchange today.

Thanks,
